verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an official MCP server with 40+ specialised tools for Phaser Editor and the hosted Game Agent. It lets agents perform editor-style actions such as creating particle emitters, reorganising scene layers and renaming objects, and the core framework is itself code-driven. Nothing documents that these tools cover everything the Editor UI does (filters, physics-body tweaks, pixel-art and tilemap editors, one-click publishing), and no general REST/OpenAPI surface was found. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, a full tool inventory mapped against Editor features, coverage of publishing and asset editors via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
